title: Felt Rain at 160
prompt: drum n bass meets aphex twin with ambient intros
description: A long, dreamy felt-piano meditation that slowly grows a brushed OberheimDMX breakbeat. Warm pads and a wandering perlin haze drift underneath while the piano stays the emotional center; the head-nod groove emerges gently and never crashes in. Aphex-tinged harmony in dorian, all morphing, no hard drops.
